item.title: 【Singles (lossless)】PACK - Jennifer Lopez - Get Right (Remixes) [FLAC / WAV]
item.description:
I had a thread on another forum and all the J.Lo fans got together to compile some very hard to find remixes from digital source. I really love all the non-dance versions of this song. I hope you enjoy them too!

Unfortunately, we couldn't get our hands on all of the versions. If someone has the missing ones, please feel free to share them, so I can add them to this post.
